title: Railway RRC SECR Raipur Apprentice 2026 - 1,644 Posts, 10th+ITI Eligible, Apply by June 4
author: Ash K.
summary: Railway Recruitment Cell South East Central Railway Raipur has released notification for 1,644 Apprentice posts across multiple trades. 10th pass with ITI eligible. Apply by June 4, 2026. No exam - selection on merit. Stipend as per Apprentices Act.
body: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), South East Central Railway (SECR), Raipur has released notification for 1,644 Apprentice posts across various trades under the Apprentices Act 1961.

DetailInformation
Total Posts1,644 Apprentice
OrganizationRRC SECR Raipur (Indian Railways)
Apply StartMay 6, 2026
Last DateJune 4, 2026
Eligibility10th pass + ITI in relevant trade
Age Limit15-24 years
SelectionMerit-based (10th + ITI marks) - NO exam
TradesFitter, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Turner, Carpenter, etc.
Duration1 year apprenticeship
StipendAs per Apprentices Act (~₹7,000-9,000/month)
Apply Atrfraipur.secr.indianrailways.gov.in
Key advantage - no exam: Selection is purely on merit - your 10th and ITI marks decide everything. No written test, no interview. Higher marks = higher chance.
Trades available: Fitter, Electrician, Welder (Gas & Electric), Machinist, Turner, Carpenter, Painter, Sheet Metal Worker, Mechanic (Diesel/Motor Vehicle/Refrigeration), Wireman, and more.
How to apply: Visit RRC SECR official website → Apprentice Recruitment 2026 → Register → Fill form → Upload 10th marksheet + ITI certificate + photo + signature → Submit before June 4.

Why Railway apprenticeship matters: After completing 1-year training, ex-apprentices get preference in future railway recruitment drives. Many RRB Group D and ALP recruitments give weightage to railway apprenticeship experience.
For railway exam preparation, check our RRB NTPC exam guide. For age relaxation details, see our age relaxation rules guide.

faqs.question: When is the last date for RRC SECR Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: June 4, 2026 at the RRC SECR Raipur official website.

faqs.question: Is there any exam for RRC SECR Apprentice?
faqs.answer: No. Selection is purely merit-based on 10th and ITI marks. No written exam or interview.

faqs.question: What qualification is needed?
faqs.answer: 10th pass (matriculation) with ITI certificate in a relevant trade.

faqs.question: What is the age limit?
faqs.answer: 15-24 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years.

faqs.question: Do Railway apprentices get permanent jobs?
faqs.answer: The apprenticeship is 1 year. Ex-apprentices get preference in future RRB Group D and ALP drives.

callout.heading: No Exam - Merit Based
callout.content: RRC SECR Raipur Apprentice selection is entirely on merit - 10th and ITI marks decide. No written test, no interview. Apply before June 4 at the SECR official website.
